# Callouts

Callouts set a note apart from the running text. Use them sparingly; a page of callouts is a page with no emphasis.

## The five kinds

::: {.callout-note}
A note adds context the reader can skip.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
A tip offers a shortcut.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
Important marks something the reader must not miss.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
A warning flags a likely mistake.
:::

::: {.callout-caution}
Caution flags something that can lose work or data.
:::

## Collapsed callouts

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Expand for the details
Long asides can start collapsed.
:::
